name: Buffer
description: Social media scheduling, analytics and engagement tool. Founded 2010, fully remote, known for transparent pricing and an open culture. Serves creators, small businesses, and agencies with per-channel pricing.

name: SocialPilot
description: Social media scheduling and management tool that sells to marketing agencies, SMBs and multi-location brands. Founded 2014, known for low prices per social account, white-label dashboards and reports, and client approval workflows. Plans are tiered by the number of social accounts and users.
